notes.summary: Independent ink reading of scan 073 only. The opening correction is F under G, the lower correction A under G, induise and singular tte sous figure are clear. Worked punctuation and the square are preserved as literal drawings. The lower draft contains three broad cancellation strokes; its final implication lies below their endpoints.
notes.math_reading_decisions: No mathematical proof or computation was performed. Following the stated figure/subdivision roles prompted comparison of the final open C′/G′ with earlier G′, and inspection of the two order shapes and implication shafts. Shape alone decides each retained reading; the final capital is not normalized. The two display chains and their primes are copied as written.
notes.author_checks: The author’s page states the failure of the symmetric assertion and, in the draft, b) ⇒ a) with references C6 and C7₀. These are transcribed claims, not validations. A separate rule cancels the C6 line. The last C7₀ line has uncertain relation to the block cancellation because no broad stroke crosses it.
notes.title_dates_pagination: Running handwritten folio 72. No date or separate title sheet. Lower draft title remains Corollaire/Comparabilité with possible 1. No additional cote marker was introduced.
notes.witness_placeholder_dispositions: H’s first struck unreadable maps to the cancelled primed capital. Its three marginal unreadables map to the three slanted lines. Its lower struck unreadable maps to the title/possible numeral. Its extra unreadable in the strengthening paragraph is provisionally aligned to the small stroke before the second C7, displaced by H before the first C7₀; no additional word-sized erased group is asserted.
notes.h_editorial_dispositions: H’s oblique-margin note correctly identifies location. Its two-long-stroke comment omits a third, shorter diagonal. Its later correction that the top relation is crossed by a broad cancellation rather than a separate strike agrees with the visible long line. The raised words are Considérons les together; their drawn enclosure/connector is retained rather than reduced to an underline under Considérons.
notes.scope_and_workflow: Only the assigned packet, conventions, notation snapshot and own outputs were used. The trailing cross-page audit originally present in C_context was disregarded after the parent’s instruction. No other reader/page, outside source, delegation, OCR or LaTeX compiler was used. The start timestamp is the first recorded inspection clock.
